ADRIENN: I...
This is a joke, right?
ADRIENN: No... Too elaborate to be a joke.
I must be dreaming.
RADOMUS: Were this but a dream, it would be all the easier.
Alas, it is not.
ADRIENN: I feel sick.
RADOMUS: Steel your nerves for a moment and answer me this:
This building has been this way for a long time, yet you are in shock.
How is this?
ADRIENN: When I left this morning, it was perfectly fine.
None of this--
This whole city--
It's wrong.
RADOMUS: As I thought.
Then allow me to tell you what I know about this Gym.
When the city was repopulated after the blackouts and earthquakes, several buildings were designated to remain untouched.
In general, these were historically-significant facilities that their legacy might be preserved.
This Gym was one such building.
ADRIENN: Blackouts? Earthquakes?
RADOMUS: This is all unheard of to you, yes?
ADRIENN: I'm really confused.
RADOMUS: Understandably.
Then allow me to clarify another thing:
A moment ago, you said "this morning" that this Gym was normal to you.
Earlier, you said you arrived at the ruin around "an hour" before us.
Do I recall correctly?
ADRIENN: Yes, but I'm... afraid I hardly follow.
RADOMUS: To put it simply, based on your description of this city and your memory of what's happened,
I believe there is only one conclusion that can be reached:
You've been frozen in time.
ADRIENN: I've-- what...?
RADOMUS: When you fell down into the ruin, as you said, how did you get there?
ADRIENN: I was checking something out in the mechanical hall behind the Grand Gates.
Someone reported they had seen some kind of light shining through the floor, so I dismantled part of it and crawled down there.
But when I lost my footing, I fell underground.
Following a natural tunnel, I eventually came to that place.
RADOMUS: When you say you were in the Grand Gates, does that mean you accessed them as normal from the Grand Stairway?
ADRIENN: Yes. Why?
RADOMUS: Then that confirms it.
The Gates have been inoperable for years.
More than a decade ago, they suddenly ceased function.
ADRIENN: I don't remember anything like that.
RADOMUS: Of course not. You were inside the ruin that entire time.
If we are to believe what El told us about that being the site of Arceus' birth, there is no telling what kind of energy afflicts that place.
It is possible the energy of the meteor concealed inside the ruin warped the flow of time, and the Gates' function with it.
ADRIENN: Then shouldn't you all have been stuck with me too?
RADOMUS: A valid concern; however, we had something you did not.
CAIN: The keys! The Ruby Ring and Amethyst Pendant!
RADOMUS: Perhaps their presence, and the energy they bear connected to the ruin, was enough to unlock you from the spell of frozen time.
ADRIENN: So I was underground for-- who knows how long-- and I had no idea...
To me it just seemed like an hour...
That's... a bad feeling.
CAIN: What are you going to do now?
ADRIENN: Well... I can't just leave this place like this.
GARDEVOIR: You're gonna try and fix your Gym?
You've got your work cut out for you!
ADRIENN: No.
Not the Gym.
I mean the whole city.
RADOMUS: You intend to fix the whole city?
ADRIENN: I intend to do what I can.
This is wrong.
This is not Reborn.
But if someone like me can do something--
Anything to bring it just a little bit closer to the way it should be...
Then that's worth doing.
Is there someone in charge that I can speak to?
CAIN: Wellllll, Ame is usually around the Grand Hall at the city center.
ADRIENN: I can't imagine that's moved far.
You have my thanks.
...For getting me out of there, too, if that is indeed what happened.
GARDEVOIR: Good luck fixing the whole city~
Maybe you'll want to stop time again to do that!
ADRIENN: Hah, maybe so.
Wouldn't that be nice?
I'll see you all around, perhaps in a slightly brighter future.
RADOMUS: Well, that turned out to be an ordeal.
GARDEVOIR: Yup! And this'll make a niiiice juicy news story, too~
RADOMUS: Before that, Gardevoir, I'll be needing you.
These two still have Gym Battles to do, after all.
GARDEVOIR: Ooooh. Well, if that's how it is~
We'll be waiting back at the Castle!
RADOMUS: Indeed. I will see you shortly.
CAIN: Hey, \PN. Do you want to walk with us back to the castle right away?
CAIN: All righty, let's all go together~
CAIN: That's fine. See you later, \PN!
RADOMUS: Whenever you're ready.
GARDEVOIR: Now accepting bets on if xe goes off the deep end!
RADOMUS: Hm. This is going to be difficult.
